meta.blurb: Mole is so tired of spring cleaning that he drops his brush and walks out into the sunshine. By evening he has found a river, a best friend called Rat, and a rich, boastful neighbour, Toad, whose newest craze is motor cars.
meta.bible: Mole: a shy, gentle animal who leaves his spring cleaning and finds the river. Rat (Water Rat): Mole's friend, who loves the river and boats and writes poems. Toad: the rich, vain, boastful owner of Toad Hall, who takes up one craze after another. Badger (Mr Badger): a wise, gruff, kind old animal who lives in the Wild Wood. Otter: Rat's friend; Portly is his young son. Pan: the great gentle god of the wild, seen on the island. Sea Rat: a sailor rat from the southern harbours. Chief Weasel: the leader of the Wild Wooders. Toad Hall: Toad's grand house by the river. The Wild Wood: the dark wood beyond the fields. Mole End: Mole's old home. The river bank. England. Fixed facts: Mole bumps into Rat on the first day of spring; Toad's caravan is wrecked by a motor car; Toad steals a car and is sentenced to twenty years in prison; he escapes dressed as a washerwoman; the Wild Wooders (weasels, stoats and ferrets) take Toad Hall; a secret tunnel leads from the river bank into the Hall. Voice and tone: warm, gentle and humorous, with a love of the countryside and the seasons; adventure without gore; friendship and home are the heart of the book; the animals talk and wear clothes, as in the original by Kenneth Grahame. Added names and fixed facts: Mole End: Mole's old home, with a small garden, a goldfish pond and plaster statues. Red Lion: the inn where Toad steals a car. Wide World: everything beyond the Wild Wood. Otter's son Portly is the small otter lost in midsummer. Jailer: the prison keeper. The Jailer's Daughter is a kind girl who helps Toad escape, and the Washerwoman is her aunt. Engine Driver: the man who helps Toad on the train. Barge Woman: the woman on the canal barge. Gipsy: the man who buys Toad's stolen horse. Chief Weasel: leader of the Wild Wooders. Sentries guard the gates of Toad Hall. Hedgehogs: two young animals who lose their way in the snow. Field mice: the carol singers at Mole End. Badger's house lies below the Wild Wood on the ruins of an ancient city. Sea Rat: a sailor from the southern harbours, in the autumn. Mediterranean, Constantinople, Sicily, Marseilles, Alexandria, Cornwall, Spain, Italy, Greece, Lisbon. Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter. The weir, the island, the willows. Cream-coloured horse pulls Toad's yellow caravan. Poop-poop is the sound of Toad's motor horn. Trapdoor: the hatch in the floor of the banqueting hall at the top of the secret tunnel.

beats.scene: Mole scrubs the low ceiling of his underground home with a whitewash brush
beats.summary: Tired of spring cleaning, Mole cries out and flings down his brush.

beats.scene: Mole scrabbles up a narrow earth tunnel toward a circle of daylight
beats.summary: Mole digs his way up to the surface and bursts out into the sunshine.

beats.scene: Mole strolls through a sunny meadow past a hedge full of rabbits
beats.summary: Mole enjoys the spring meadow and ignores the jeering rabbits.

beats.scene: Mole sits on the bank watching a broad, shining river slide by
beats.summary: Mole sees a river for the first time and is enchanted.

beats.scene: A whiskered Water Rat looks out from a hole across the river
beats.summary: Rat appears from his hole and rows over to greet Mole.

beats.scene: Mole sits in a little blue boat while Rat rows between green banks
beats.summary: Rat takes Mole out on the water and praises messing about in boats.

beats.scene: Mole points over green meadows at a dark line of distant trees
beats.summary: Rat tells Mole that the Wild Wood is a place to avoid.

beats.scene: Rat unpacks a wicker hamper of cold meats and pickles on the shady bank
beats.summary: Rat spreads a splendid picnic and Mole is overjoyed.

beats.scene: An otter chats on the bank while a striped Badger peeps out and vanishes
beats.summary: Otter joins the picnic and shy Badger glimpses them and hides.

beats.scene: Mole stands in the boat with the oars as it starts to tip
beats.summary: Mole insists on rowing and turns the boat upside down.

beats.scene: Rat pulls a dripping Mole onto the grass while the boat floats upside down
beats.summary: Rat rescues Mole and laughs off the accident.

beats.scene: Rat dives to bring back the floating picnic basket, cushions and oars
beats.summary: Rat recovers the basket and every scattered thing from the water.

beats.scene: Rat leads a shivering Mole to a neat round hole in the river bank
beats.summary: Rat takes Mole home to his snug house in the bank.

beats.scene: Mole in a dressing gown steams beside a bright fire in Rat's room
beats.summary: Rat dries Mole by the fire and makes him comfortable.

beats.scene: Mole and Rat talk by the firelight with the river lapping outside
beats.summary: Mole thanks Rat, who invites him to stay and learn the river.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole at supper, talking about their neighbours
beats.summary: Rat tells Mole about his rich, boastful friend Toad.

beats.scene: Rat rows Mole upstream toward a red-brick house with green lawns
beats.summary: Next day the two friends travel by river to Toad Hall.

beats.scene: Toad runs across a green lawn with open arms to greet his friends
beats.summary: Toad welcomes them and says boating is out of fashion.

beats.scene: Toad shows a canary-yellow caravan with red wheels in the stable yard
beats.summary: Toad proudly shows off his new gipsy caravan.

beats.scene: Toad pleads with Rat and Mole beside the yellow caravan
beats.summary: Toad persuades Rat and Mole to travel with him on the open road.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole pack the yellow caravan while Toad bustles about
beats.summary: Next morning Toad hurries everyone along and the caravan sets out.

beats.scene: The yellow caravan creaks along a quiet lane between tall hedges
beats.summary: The friends travel through the summer countryside, with Toad walking at the horse's head.

beats.scene: Three friends rest under a spreading tree with the horse grazing near
beats.summary: At noon they halt to eat, and Toad boasts of the places they will visit.

beats.scene: Three friends sit on the caravan steps as the stars come out
beats.summary: They camp on a common and watch the stars after supper.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole make breakfast over a fire while Toad lies in bed
beats.summary: Rat and Mole do the chores while Toad sleeps late.

beats.scene: A great cloud of dust rolls toward the caravan along a white road
beats.summary: A speeding motor car appears and roars past the caravan.

beats.scene: The horse rears and the yellow caravan crashes into a ditch
beats.summary: The horse bolts in terror and the caravan is wrecked.

beats.scene: Toad sits in the dusty road, gazing happily after the car
beats.summary: Toad forgets the wreck and falls in love with motor cars.

beats.scene: Rat shakes Toad by the shoulders beside the wrecked caravan
beats.summary: Rat begs Toad to help, but Toad declares he will buy a motor car.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole lead the horse to a country inn, leaving Toad dreaming
beats.summary: The friends leave Toad at an inn and take the train home.

beats.scene: Rat shows Mole how to hold the oars in a little boat at dawn
beats.summary: Rat teaches Mole to row, morning after morning.

beats.scene: Mole paddles in the shallows while Rat floats beside him
beats.summary: Rat teaches Mole to swim in the warm water.

beats.scene: A kingfisher flashes over the water as Rat points out river creatures
beats.summary: Rat teaches Mole the birds, fish and plants of the river.

beats.scene: Rat scribbles a song at sunset while ducks dabble among the reeds
beats.summary: Rat composes a little song about the ducks.

beats.scene: Otter sits with his feet in the water, telling stories to Mole and Rat
beats.summary: Otter visits often and boasts about his small son Portly.

beats.scene: Golden cornfields and hay carts under a warm sky beside the river
beats.summary: The summer passes into harvest time.

beats.scene: Yellow leaves drift onto the river as berries redden along the hedge
beats.summary: Autumn arrives and the days grow shorter.

beats.scene: Frost glitters on the reeds while Rat dozes in an armchair by his fire
beats.summary: Winter frosts come and Rat grows sleepy.

beats.scene: Snow covers the river bank as Mole looks out of Rat's window
beats.summary: Snow falls and Mole stares toward the Wild Wood.

beats.scene: Mole asks Rat about Badger while Rat sits half asleep by the fire
beats.summary: Mole wants to meet Badger, but Rat says they must wait.

beats.scene: Rat sleeps in an armchair with a poem on his knee as Mole fidgets
beats.summary: One cold afternoon Rat falls asleep and Mole grows restless.

beats.scene: Mole tiptoes out of the door and crosses frozen white fields alone
beats.summary: Mole slips out and heads across the snow toward the Wild Wood.

beats.scene: Mole stands at the edge of the Wild Wood among black bare trees
beats.summary: Mole reaches the wood and walks in between the bare trees.

beats.scene: A narrow face with hard bright eyes peers from a hole among roots
beats.summary: Mole sees a face watching him, and then many more.

beats.scene: Mole freezes in a dim wood as unseen whistling echoes between the trees
beats.summary: A thin whistle sounds behind him, followed by a pattering of feet.

beats.scene: Mole runs wildly between dark trunks, tripping over roots and brambles
beats.summary: Terrified, Mole runs blindly through the wood.

beats.scene: Mole crouches shaking inside a hollow under an old beech tree
beats.summary: Mole hides in a hollow tree while the whistles pass outside.

beats.scene: Rat wakes by the dying fire and sees small footprints in the snow

beats.scene: Rat strides calmly along Mole's tracks while faces glare from the holes
beats.summary: Rat enters the Wild Wood without fear and the watchers draw back.

beats.scene: Rat kneels at the mouth of a hollow tree and finds Mole inside
beats.summary: Rat finds Mole and comforts him.

beats.scene: Thick snow whirls through the dark wood as Rat and Mole trudge on
beats.summary: Snow falls heavily and the friends cannot find the way home.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole struggle through deep drifts between identical white tree trunks
beats.summary: They plod on through the storm and Mole grows exhausted.

beats.scene: Mole tumbles in the snow and clutches his bruised shin
beats.summary: Mole trips over something hidden under the snow and cuts his leg.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole dig out a doormat and a green door from the snow
beats.summary: Rat recognises a boot-scraper, and they dig out a mat and a door.

beats.scene: Rat tugs the bell-pull beside a brass plate that reads Mr Badger
beats.summary: Rat rings the bell and they wait in the snow.

beats.scene: Badger in a dressing gown peers sleepily through a narrow opening of his door
beats.summary: Badger answers grumpily, then welcomes them warmly.

beats.scene: Badger leads two guests down a lamp-lit passage to a warm kitchen
beats.summary: Badger takes them to his kitchen, where hams hang from the beams.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole sit on benches while Badger listens gravely by the fire
beats.summary: Rat tells their story, and Badger kindly forgives Mole.

beats.scene: Badger lays a table with cold meat, bread and cheese for his guests
beats.summary: Badger feeds the hungry travellers a hearty supper.

beats.scene: Badger frowns and shakes his head by the fire while Rat talks
beats.summary: Badger asks for news, and Rat tells him about Toad and his cars.

beats.scene: Two young hedgehogs eat porridge in Badger's kitchen as Rat and Mole enter
beats.summary: At breakfast Rat and Mole meet two young hedgehogs lost in the snow the day before.

beats.scene: Badger sits by the fire telling of a vanished city beneath the Wild Wood
beats.summary: Badger tells how a great city of people once stood where the Wild Wood grows.

beats.scene: Tree roots grow through old stone halls beneath a leafy forest
beats.summary: The people vanished, the forest grew over the ruins and the animals took shelter there.

beats.scene: Mole admires stone arches, passages and storerooms in Badger's underground house
beats.summary: Badger shows Mole around his house and Mole admires it.

beats.scene: Mole and Badger sit contentedly in a comfortable underground parlour
beats.summary: Mole and Badger agree that there is no home like one underground.

beats.scene: Badger carries a lantern through a long, straight tunnel with Rat and Mole behind
beats.summary: Badger offers a short cut home through his tunnel under the wood.

beats.scene: Badger raises his lantern in the tunnel and speaks earnestly to his friends
beats.summary: In the tunnel Badger says the Wild Wooders respect him, and promises to take Toad in hand.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole step blinking into bright snowy daylight at the wood's edge
beats.summary: The tunnel ends at the edge of the wood and they say farewell.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole cross glittering white fields toward the river bank
beats.summary: Rat and Mole walk home across the snowy fields.

beats.scene: Mole sits by Rat's fire, gazing into the flames and thinking of home
beats.summary: Back at Rat's house, Mole starts to think of his own old home.

beats.scene: Mole in a long scarf walks beside the frozen river while Rat naps indoors
beats.summary: The winter weeks pass, and Mole's old home comes back to his mind.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole walk briskly across frozen fields under a pale winter sun
beats.summary: Rat takes Mole on a long country walk.

beats.scene: Lit cottage windows glow in a village as the two walkers pass at dusk
beats.summary: At dusk they pass a village where families sit at their suppers.

beats.scene: Mole stands rigid in a frosty lane, nose lifted, as Rat walks on
beats.summary: In a frosty lane Mole catches a faint, familiar smell.

beats.scene: Mole stands alone in the road under the stars with tears on his face
beats.summary: It is the smell of his old home, and Mole begins to cry.

beats.scene: Rat turns back along the lane and puts an arm round weeping Mole
beats.summary: Rat notices at last and comforts Mole.

beats.scene: Mole wipes his eyes and speaks earnestly to Rat in the starlight
beats.summary: Mole explains how much he longs for his shabby old home.

beats.scene: Rat points ahead down the lane, ready to follow Mole's nose
beats.summary: Rat promises that they will find the house, however long it takes.

beats.scene: Mole follows a scent past a hedge and over a frozen ditch
beats.summary: Mole's nose leads them across the fields to a bank.

beats.scene: Mole stands before a small door with the words Mole End painted above it
beats.summary: They crawl through a tunnel to the door of Mole's old home.

beats.scene: Mole stands in a dusty hall with cobwebs and a sheet-covered chair
beats.summary: Mole sees his neglected home, cold and covered in dust.

beats.scene: Rat lights a lamp that shows small rooms and plaster statues under dust
beats.summary: Rat lights a lamp and the little house appears.

beats.scene: Mole slumps in a chair with his face in his paws, weeping
beats.summary: Mole is ashamed that there is no fire and no supper.

beats.scene: Rat laughs and lights a small fire in the grate of the parlour
beats.summary: Rat cheers him up and lights a fire.

beats.scene: Rat holds up a tin of sardines and a sausage beside an open cupboard
beats.summary: Rat finds sardines, biscuits and a sausage in the cupboards.

beats.scene: Small feet shuffle in the dark passage outside Mole's door as lanterns bob
beats.summary: They hear whispers and a small choir tuning up outside.

beats.scene: Field mice in red scarves sing in a ring, holding lanterns
beats.summary: Rat opens the door to field mice singing carols.

beats.scene: Rat presses coins into a small mouse's paw beside a table of hot drinks
beats.summary: Mole invites the singers in and Rat sends one to buy supper.

beats.scene: Mole's little table groans with food while mice and friends eat merrily
beats.summary: The mice return with a feast and everyone eats together.

beats.scene: Mole lies in his own old bed under a quilt, smiling in the lamplight
beats.summary: Mole goes to bed in his old home, happy at last.

beats.scene: Badger stands grimly at Rat's door as the new year begins
beats.summary: Toad keeps wrecking cars, and Badger comes to say that it is time to act.

beats.scene: Badger and Rat carry a kicking Toad in goggles up the steps
beats.summary: At Toad Hall they find Toad dressed for driving and carry him indoors.

beats.scene: Badger lectures Toad, who dabs his eyes in an armchair
beats.summary: Toad pretends to be sorry but refuses to promise to give up cars.

beats.scene: Badger turns the key in the door of Toad's bedroom
beats.summary: Badger locks Toad in his bedroom and the friends take turns on guard.

beats.scene: Toad lies groaning on his bed as Rat peers through the doorway
beats.summary: Toad pretends to be dying, and Rat goes to fetch a doctor.

beats.scene: Toad climbs down a rope of knotted bedsheets from a high window
beats.summary: Toad escapes through the window and runs off across the fields.

beats.scene: Toad eats a large lunch at the Red Lion while a car waits outside
beats.summary: Toad strolls to an inn, eats a big lunch and sees a car in the yard.

beats.scene: Toad sits at the wheel of a stolen car, racing down a country lane
beats.summary: Toad cannot resist: he starts the car and drives off at great speed.

beats.scene: Policemen chase a speeding car through a village scattering hens
beats.summary: The police chase the stolen car and arrest Toad.

beats.scene: A stern judge in a wig sentences Toad in a crowded courtroom
beats.summary: Toad is sentenced to twenty years in prison.

beats.scene: Otter stands anxiously at the water's edge at dusk, looking up the river
beats.summary: In midsummer Otter tells Rat and Mole that little Portly is missing.

beats.scene: Otter keeps watch at the old ford while Rat and Mole stand beside him
beats.summary: Otter waits at the ford where Portly learned to swim, and his friends promise to search.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole row upstream at twilight, calling softly along the dark banks
beats.summary: They row upstream in the dusk, calling Portly's name.

beats.scene: A full moon rises over the willows as the boat glides on silver water
beats.summary: The moon rises, and the river turns to silver.

beats.scene: Rat stops rowing and lifts his head, listening to faint music
beats.summary: Rat hears a strange, sweet music that Mole cannot hear.

beats.scene: The boat drifts between banks of meadowsweet and wild roses as the stars fade
beats.summary: Rat steers toward the music, and the air fills with the scent of flowers.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole step onto a small flowery island beside a weir
beats.summary: They reach a quiet island beside a weir and go ashore.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole kneel trembling in a green clearing in the first light
beats.summary: Rat and Mole feel a great and gentle presence close by.

beats.scene: A horned god holds his pipes while a small otter sleeps beside him
beats.summary: They see the god Pan, with Portly asleep between his hooves.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole row home at sunrise with sleepy Portly between them
beats.summary: The vision fades, they forget it, and they bring Portly home to Otter.

beats.scene: A heavy iron door closes on Toad in a damp stone cell
beats.summary: Toad is shut in a dungeon deep inside an ancient castle.

beats.scene: Toad lies on a stone floor sobbing in a damp cell
beats.summary: Toad sobs in despair, remembering his house and his friends.

beats.scene: A kind girl brings a tray of tea and toast to a sobbing Toad
beats.summary: The jailer's daughter, who loves animals, brings Toad tea and toast.

beats.scene: Toad sits up with a teacup, boasting to the jailer's daughter
beats.summary: Toad tells her about Toad Hall and she listens with interest.

beats.scene: The girl whispers a plan to Toad in the lamplight
beats.summary: The girl says her aunt is the prison washerwoman and she has an idea.

beats.scene: Toad shakes his head proudly, then slowly begins to smile
beats.summary: Toad first refuses to dress as a washerwoman, then agrees.

beats.scene: A plump old washerwoman counts coins in Toad's cell
beats.summary: Toad pays the aunt, who agrees to lend him her clothes.

beats.scene: Toad looks at himself in a bonnet and long gown, an absurd sight
beats.summary: Toad puts on the washerwoman's clothes and looks surprisingly convincing.

beats.scene: Toad in a bonnet and shawl walks past stern guards through iron gates
beats.summary: Toad walks past the guards, who take him for the washerwoman.

beats.scene: Toad in washerwoman's clothes hurries down a hill toward the lights of the town
beats.summary: Free at last, Toad hurries through the dark to the railway station.

beats.scene: Toad in a bonnet stands on the platform, searching empty pockets
beats.summary: At the station Toad finds he has no money for a ticket.

beats.scene: An engine driver leans from his cab to talk to a washerwoman
beats.summary: The driver offers a free ride to a washerwoman who will wash his shirts.

beats.scene: Toad stands on the footplate of a speeding engine, bonnet blown crooked
beats.summary: Toad rides the engine and begins to brag.

beats.scene: The driver looks back at a second engine chasing them, full of policemen
beats.summary: Another engine, full of police, chases them, and Toad confesses.

beats.scene: Toad shovels coal into a glowing furnace as the engine races on
beats.summary: Toad and the driver feed the fire to keep ahead of the police.

beats.scene: The engine nears the black mouth of a tunnel as the driver points
beats.summary: The driver tells Toad to jump off after the tunnel.

beats.scene: Toad leaps from the slowing engine and rolls into long grass by a wood
beats.summary: Toad jumps off and the police engine thunders past without seeing him.

beats.scene: Toad curls up in a hollow tree in a dark wood
beats.summary: Toad spends a cold, frightening night in the wood.

beats.scene: A horse tows a barge along a misty canal as a woman waves
beats.summary: In the morning Toad finds a canal, and a barge woman invites him aboard.

beats.scene: Toad splashes in the canal as a furious woman shakes her fist
beats.summary: Toad ruins the washing, shouts that he is Toad, and is thrown in the canal.

beats.scene: Toad, dripping, gallops bareback along the towpath on a big horse
beats.summary: Toad takes the barge horse and gallops away in a fury.

beats.scene: A gipsy stirs a pot by a roadside fire while Toad holds the horse
beats.summary: Toad sells the horse to a gipsy for a few coins and a hot breakfast.

beats.scene: Toad, full of stew, walks cheerfully along a white road in his bonnet
beats.summary: Refreshed and well fed, Toad walks on feeling clever.

beats.scene: Toad sings loudly of his own cleverness as he strides along a lane
beats.summary: Toad composes a boastful song about his own escapes.

beats.scene: A motor car draws up beside Toad on a country road
beats.summary: A motor car stops, and its owners offer the old washerwoman a lift.

beats.scene: Toad in a bonnet grabs the steering wheel as the driver shouts
beats.summary: Toad climbs in, then cannot resist seizing the wheel.

beats.scene: A speeding car plunges nose first into a pond as Toad flies off
beats.summary: The car crashes into a pond and Toad flies through the air.

beats.scene: Toad hitches up his skirts and runs across a meadow with angry people behind
beats.summary: Toad runs for his life while the owners splash out of the pond.

beats.scene: Toad hides in a ditch beneath a hedge at night, muddy and hungry
beats.summary: For many days Toad hides by day and creeps along lanes by night.

beats.scene: Toad trudges wearily down a hill toward distant willows and a silver river
beats.summary: Toad sees his own river and decides to seek Rat.

beats.scene: Swallows gather on a roof in golden autumn light as Rat watches
beats.summary: Swallows gather for their journey and Rat feels uneasy.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole sit by the river in autumn while Rat gazes south
beats.summary: Rat admits he longs to follow the swallows south.

beats.scene: Rat walks alone along a dusty white road at the edge of the fields
beats.summary: Rat walks along the high road to shake off his restlessness.

beats.scene: A weather-beaten sailor rat with a gold earring walks along the dusty road
beats.summary: Rat meets a travelling Sea Rat and brings him home for a meal.

beats.summary: Over lunch the Sea Rat tells of life on ships, storms and calm seas.

beats.scene: The Sea Rat describes sunny harbours, orange groves and white towns
beats.summary: He describes the sunny harbours and fruit markets of the south.

beats.summary: The Sea Rat says the sea calls those who have heard it, and Rat falls under the spell.

beats.summary: The Sea Rat leaves for the sea, and Rat stares after him.

beats.summary: Rat starts packing to follow the Sea Rat south.

beats.summary: Mole blocks the door and holds Rat back until the spell breaks.

beats.scene: Rat and Mole read poems by the fire as autumn rain taps the window

beats.summary: One stormy night someone knocks at Rat's door.

beats.summary: Rat recognises Toad under the mud and the rags.
